description: Publish to a Facebook Page and its linked Instagram Business account

actions.description: Publish a post to the connected Facebook Page. Media is resolved from the Work Item's uploaded assets when no explicit media URL is supplied.

params.message: Post text (required unless link, media params or work_item_id media is supplied)
params.link: URL to attach to the post (optional)
params.image_url: Publicly reachable image URL to attach as a photo post (optional; resolved from the Work Item's assets when omitted)
params.video_url: Publicly reachable video URL (optional; a Work Item video asset is uploaded resumably instead)
params.scheduled_publish_time: ISO-8601 instant to schedule the post for (optional; immediate when omitted)
params.work_item_id: Work Item whose uploaded media assets this post publishes (optional)
params.target_id: Post publish target this invocation fulfils (optional; carried for correlation only)

actions.description: Delete a post from the connected Facebook Page, including one that is still scheduled and has not gone live

params.post_id: Platform id of the post to delete (required)

actions.description: Read a Facebook Page post's publish state — whether a scheduled post has gone live yet — plus its permalink

params.post_id: Platform id of the post to read (required)

actions.description: Publish an image or video to the Instagram Business account linked to the connected Page. Creates the media container and publishes it in the same invocation, at fire time.

params.media_type: IMAGE, VIDEO or REELS (optional; inferred from the resolved media when omitted)
params.image_url: Publicly reachable image URL (optional; resolved from the Work Item's assets when omitted)
params.video_url: Publicly reachable video URL (optional; resolved from the Work Item's assets when omitted)
params.caption: Caption text, including any hashtags (optional)
params.work_item_id: Work Item whose uploaded media assets this post publishes (optional)
params.target_id: Post publish target this invocation fulfils (optional; carried for correlation only)
